verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a scrape endpoint that turns a URL into easily parseable text, and its API and Go SDK expose webpage scraping and extraction from complicated websites. So the core of URL-to-clean-text is claimed. The evidence never says the scraper handles anti-bot blocking or JavaScript rendering, and it never describes the output format as LLM-ready (e.g., markdown). Missing for 10: documented handling of blocking and anti-bot measures, JS rendering support, a specified clean or markdown output format, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scrape quality.
